document_title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines applicability for SUAREZ.CFI website redesign
scope: 15 category overview pages plus all 158 topic articles, mapped to responsive website design rather than native Apple compliance.

coverage.all_topic_articles_reviewed: Prior assigned research is marked complete; per-item records indicate the review source.
coverage.verification_state: Evidence-linked web implementation; scoped appearance/navigation/sky checks pass. Comprehensive per-topic HIG compliance is not asserted; device and assistive-technology release checks remain open.
limits: A test or screenshot may support only the named behavior/state and is not proof of broad guideline conformance.
Physical iPhone Safari, installed PWA, VoiceOver, and true browser text zoom have not been verified.
Synthetic 200% text captures are fixture evidence only.
The final refreshed static coverage audit passes with zero findings, including independently built iframe/app shells.

design_decisions: Modern Garmin touch is the default visual language across the website and tools.
Smoked glass is limited to the floating dock and menus; article, form, and result surfaces stay matte.

Persistent site destinations and contextual app actions have distinct semantics. Desktop dock: Home, Training, Learn, Blog, Tools, Fly with Diego, Menu. About is available in Menu only. Mobile dock: Home, Learn, Tools, Menu.
Tool-specific steps and actions remain in their app context. A bottom contextual control panel may group app actions; it must not be presented as the global destination navigation.
Preserve routes, copy, calculations, data, exports, and category/risk semantics.
Preserve the homepage animated sky JS/CSS/assets/geometry and existing reduced-motion behavior. No dock magnification.
Aero Lab remains desktop-only by explicit product decision; native platform-specific HIG details are not literal requirements for this web experience.

EV-STATIC-001.label: Static route and source audit snapshot
EV-STATIC-001.supports: Final audit: 523/523 canonical routes exist; 551 HTML files inventoried; zero static failures, including ten independently built app documents. Homepage hero subtree and five sky assets match baseline; nine selected core sources match. This is source evidence, not individual browser proof for all routes.

EV-APPEARANCE-005.label: Appearance unit tests (5)
EV-APPEARANCE-005.supports: Dark default, blocked storage, global preference precedence/legacy import, live system/storage synchronization, solid-control/reduced-transparency composition, invalid values. Node test run recorded below.

EV-NAV-005.label: Navigation and adapter unit tests (5)
EV-NAV-005.supports: Native disabled-step delegation, CertPath prerequisites, rerender/focus restoration, Menu Escape/outside dismissal, embedded appearance synchronization and single navigation ownership. Does not establish full keyboard or assistive-technology conformance.

EV-SKY-006.label: Homepage sky tests (6)
EV-SKY-006.supports: Automatic day/night behavior, timezone/date cases, 30 fps/offscreen pause/resume, reduced-motion behavior, graphics-failure fallback/context recovery; static baseline asset digests match.

EV-SCREEN-001.label: Captured implementation screenshots
EV-SCREEN-001.supports: Visual samples at desktop/tablet/mobile and dark/day where named; screenshots document specific captured states only, not all routes, viewports, users, or accessibility outcomes.

EV-ZOOM-FIXTURE-001.label: Synthetic 200% text QA captures
EV-ZOOM-FIXTURE-001.supports: Synthetic text enlargement at a 320px fixture is captured for visual review. This is not a true browser text-zoom test and remains unverified as browser behavior.

EV-SKY-GEOMETRY-001.label: Homepage sky geometry captures
EV-SKY-GEOMETRY-001.supports: Recorded baseline/current geometry and desktop images support preservation review. They do not prove every device/viewport rendering.
